items.title: Singapore U16 girls beat Bahrain 4-0, level with Indonesia going into AFC qualifier decider
items.summary: A brace from Amelia Tan helped Singapore's Under-16 girls beat Bahrain 4-0 at Bishan Stadium, maintaining a perfect start to the AFC U17 Women's Asian Cup China 2027 qualifiers. With Indonesia also winning its matches, the two co-leaders went into the final Group B game level on six points, meeting at Bishan on 11 October for the only qualifying spot to the 2027 finals.

items.title: Singapore U16 girls open AFC qualifying campaign with 1-0 win over Saudi Arabia
items.summary: Singapore's Under-16 girls opened their AFC U17 Women's Asian Cup China 2027 qualifiers with a hard-fought 1-0 win over Saudi Arabia at Bishan Stadium, Amelia Tan scoring the only goal. Singapore is hosting Group B of the qualifiers (with Indonesia, Saudi Arabia and Bahrain) from 5 to 11 October; only the group winner advances direct to the 2027 finals in China.

items.title: Gavin Lee names a 25-man Lions squad for the ASEAN Hyundai Cup 2026
items.summary: Head coach Gavin Lee confirmed the 25 players representing Singapore at the ASEAN Championship Hyundai Cup 2026, which runs from 24 July to 26 August. The Lions open their Group A campaign away to Cambodia in Phnom Penh on Friday 24 July, return home to face Timor-Leste on 27 July, then travel to defending champions Vietnam on 31 July.

items.title: Tickets released for Singapore's ASEAN Hyundai Cup home fixtures at Jalan Besar Stadium
items.summary: FAS put tickets for the Lions' home Group A fixture against Timor-Leste on sale at 11am, with tickets for the 7 August home fixture against Indonesia following on Wednesday 22 July, also at 11am. Both fixtures are at Jalan Besar Stadium.
